best_idea: Each side writes a small summary of the shared state into a ring once per tic, sends it with its command, and compares the received value with its own copy one ring-lap earlier; a mismatch is a desync report, so the check costs a lag but never sends the state.
decision_why: Frankendom's server holds the authoritative fight, so only a lagged state digest from a client replay or Pit re-simulation, compared with the server record and flagged into the one ledger, transfers; the donor's stop-on-mismatch is rejected and the digest never decides a hit or a kill.
acceptance: A recorded fight replayed on a client with an altered digest (one fighter's HP changed at tic N) produces one desync flag at tic N or within one ring lap after it, the server keeps its own result, and the fight continues.
